verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party AI that generates or improves prompts, flows, or test cases from a description. The context-hub MCP index and the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md scaffolding only support the user's own external coding agent, which is a user-side workaround. Pipecat Evals runs conversations that the user describes themselves; it does not generate test cases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description
